name: How to Put Multiple PDF Pages on One Sheet
description: Print 2, 4, 6, 9 or 16 PDF pages per sheet — 100% in your browser.

step.name: Add your PDF files
step.text: Click Choose files or drop one or more PDFs into the drop zone.

step.name: Pick pages per sheet
step.text: Choose 2, 4, 6, 9 or 16, Booklet to print and fold, or Invoices on A4 for invoices at their real size.

step.name: Download the new PDF
step.text: Click Arrange Pages — the PDF downloads immediately, ready to print.
